milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the polished granite slab (at spawn-relative [3, 1, 3] on a quartz pedestal) and face toward it, modeling 'the player can see the target block'. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable exploration distance within the 12-block scene, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the slab rather than just being nearby.
